reason: Upload-only official API (https://developer.olx.ro/api/doc): OLX Romania Partner API (developer.olx.ro): register an application to post/manage own adverts and messages; not a public search API. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
